programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Kaitlin & Cam Kaitlin and Cam's Vegas fling turns into the real thing; Kaitlin believes she's met her Prince Charming; Kaitlin can see a future with Cam, but there's just one problem, he's hiding her.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.desc: S02 E21 — Shara & Rudy Chicago chefs Shara and Rudy fell in love over a year ago; with a shared passion for Caribbean food, they plan to open a restaurant together; however, Shara can't move forward until she knows why Rudy is hiding her from his family.
programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

programme.desc: S4 E2 — Rehearsal Kendall, Shiv and Roman consider an aggressive play on the Matsson deal. Connor tries to make the most of his rehearsal dinner.
programme.title: Succession

programme.desc: S4 E3 — Connor's Wedding While Logan doles out an unsavoury task ahead of his trip to meet Matsson, Connor fixates on minutia at his wedding.
programme.title: Succession

programme.desc: S3 E1 — The Law of Vacant Places The black comedy drama inspired by the Coen brothers' Oscar-winning film returns, this time set in 2010. Parole officer Ray Stussy wants to marry his girlfriend and goes to ask his successful businessman brother Emmit for money to buy a ring, but he refuses and sparks a chain of events that plunges the Minnesota town into chaos, with police officer Gloria Burgle finding herself at the heart of it. Ewan McGregor stars as both Stussy brothers, with Carrie Coon, Mary Elizabeth Winstead and David Thewlis.
programme.title: Fargo

programme.desc: S4 E1 Return of the period drama set in the 1880s. Agnes van Rhijn seizes an opportunity to regain her position, Marian forges a new path for herself and Peggy works to be accepted by her future in-laws. Starring Louisa Jacobson.
programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Part III The townies go bear hunting against orders. Thinking Grace is in trouble, Pam confronts Valerie.
programme.title: Crystal Lake

programme.desc: S1 E7 — The Black Spot A vigilante attack on the Black Spot unleashes long-dormant forces. After, Dick helps uncover another crucial artefact.
programme.title: It: Welcome to Derry

programme.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book 'Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.
programme.title: Constantine

programme.desc: Stylish historical epic retelling the fierce battle at Thermopylae in 481 BC. The Spartan king, Leonidas, and his tiny army of 300 followers provided inspiration for the whole of Greece as they fought the massed ranks of the Persian army whose commander, King Xerxes, had up to a million warriors at his disposal.

It's been nearly a decade since Tarzan, also known as John Clayton III, left Africa to live in Victorian England with his wife Jane. Danger lurks on the horizon as Leon Rom, a treacherous envoy for King Leopold, devises a scheme that lures the couple to the Congo. Rom plans to capture Tarzan and deliver him to an old enemy in exchange for diamonds. When Jane becomes a pawn in his devious plot, Tarzan must return to the jungle to save the woman he loves.
programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan

programme.desc: In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.
programme.title: The Scorpion King

programme.desc: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.
programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor

programme.desc: Reeling from a traumatic tour of duty in Afghanistan, Joey, a former special forces soldier, returns to London to face another kind of war: life on the streets as a damaged, homeless veteran. In an attempt to rehabilitate himself, Joey assumes another man's identity and seeks the aid of Sister Cristina, a young nun who works at an inner-city parish.
programme.title: Hummingbird

programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.
programme.title: First Blood

programme.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers unite to explore a mythical, uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean. Cut off from everything they know, they venture into the domain of the mighty Kong, igniting the ultimate battle between man and nature. As their mission of discovery soon becomes one of survival, they must fight to escape from a primal world where humanity does not belong.
programme.title: Kong: Skull Island

programme.desc: Fuelled by his restored faith in humanity, and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater threat. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to recruit a team to stand against this newly-awakened enemy. Despite the formation of an unprecedented league of heroes in Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash, it may be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.
programme.title: Justice League

programme.desc: In Rio de Janeiro, an ex-con and an ex-cop join forces against a corrupt businessman who wants them both dead.
programme.title: Fast & Furious 5

programme.desc: Since Dom and Brian's heist in Rio they must live as fugitives. Meanwhile, Agent Hobbs has been tracking a gang of lethally skilled mercenary drivers. Hobbs asks Dom and his crew for help in exchange for full pardons for everyone.

programme.desc: After defeating international terrorist Owen Shaw, Dominic Toretto, Brian O'Conner and the rest of the crew have separated to return to more normal lives. However, Deckard Shaw, Owen's older brother, is thirsty for revenge. A slick government agent offers to help Dom and company take care of Shaw in exchange for their help in rescuing a kidnapped computer hacker who has developed a powerful surveillance program.

programme.desc: Martial arts extravaganza in which twin brothers, both expert fighters, are reunited after many years to avenge their parents' murder. After the killing, engineered by their father's unscrupulous business partner, the young sons are separated. One becomes a Hong Kong smuggler, the other a Beverly Hills aerobics instructor, but despite their very different lifestyles, they are united in the desire for justice.

programme.desc: Outrageous antics ensue when Jim, Michelle, Stifler and the gang get back together for their 13-year high school reunion.
programme.title: American Pie: Reunion

programme.desc: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.
programme.title: Instant Family

programme.desc: Wealthy businessman, Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.
programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme

programme.desc: A 70-year-old widower discovers that retirement isn't all it's cracked up to be. Seizing an opportunity to get back in the game, he becomes a senior intern at an online fashion site, founded and run by Jules Ostin.
programme.title: The Intern

programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down.
programme.title: The Naked Gun

programme.desc: Preparing to host her daughter's wedding on an idyllic Greek isle, a strong, independent hotel owner finds that the guests include three men from her past whom her daughter secretly invited because she suspects one of them might be her father.
programme.title: Mamma Mia!

programme.desc: In 1979, young Donna falls in love and falls pregnant after university. In the present day, her daughter Sophie gets to know her mother's old friends and ex-partners as she renovates Donna's villa on the Greek island of Kalokairi.
programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again

programme.desc: Four Los Angeles singles experience undeniable chemistry, and pair off to follow their attraction to its logical conclusion. Afterwards, each new couple tries to make love last in the real world.
programme.title: About Last Night

programme.desc: Two rival bookshop owners are unaware that they are conducting a secret romance with each other on the Internet. When they discover the truth, they must prevent their business rivalry from interfering with their growing personal intimacy.
programme.title: You've Got Mail

programme.desc: Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.
programme.title: Yesterday

programme.desc: Greg and Pam have been together for ten years, and now they're the proud parents of two adorable twins. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.
programme.title: Little Fockers

programme.desc: West Virginia family man Jimmy Logan teams up with his one-armed brother Clyde and sister Mellie to steal money from the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. Jimmy also recruits demolition expert Joe Bang to help them break into the track's underground system. Complications arise when a mix-up forces the crew to pull off the heist during a popular NASCAR race, while also trying to dodge a relentless FBI agent.
programme.title: Logan Lucky

programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished. Trying to help some teenagers, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now David's in big debt to his supplier, and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.
programme.title: We're the Millers

programme.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.
programme.title: The Man With Two Brains

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.
programme.title: Tootsie

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
programme.title: Anaconda

programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.
programme.title: Army of Darkness

programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.
programme.title: Batman Returns

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.
programme.title: Basic Instinct

programme.desc: Thriller set at the Stanley Cup ice hockey finals. It's Game 7 and the winner will lift the trophy but with the Vice President attending, a criminal has his eyes on a bigger prize. Holding the VP hostage, his demands are backed up by the shooting of selected hostages and the threat of bombs planted around the stadium. However, a rink security guard, whose kids are in the crowd, refuses to be cowed.
programme.title: Sudden Death

programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.
programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike

programme.desc: Something strange is afoot in Sherwood Forest when Robin Hood and his very merry men poke fun at all things green and scarlet in this parody. Robin and his gang have to fight evil Prince John while King Richard is off on a crusade.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights

programme.desc: Update of the 'Cyrano de Bergerac' story about a long-nosed fire chief who falls in love with a beautiful astronomer. The chief is too ashamed of his appearance to make advances himself but is drawn into assisting his rival, a dull but handsome visiting fireman, from behind the scenes as his chances of love are hampered by his lack of confidence.
programme.title: Roxanne

programme.desc: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.
programme.title: Matilda

programme.desc: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. programme.title: Casper

programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.
programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

programme.desc: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.
